D-LEDGER.difference_from_control: one advisory check_compatibility tool and its concise prompt contract
mechanisms: nondominated compatibility evidence retained in the same Agent session

case_selection.prior_evidence: both historical V2 arms exhausted the request cap without forming a candidate; sparse global feedback showed large nonmonotonic transitions
historical trajectories showed a long 61-to-26-to-2-to-2-to-2-to-2-to-0 compatibility path

claim_boundary.allowed: mechanism qualification and directional evidence on consumed design cases
forbidden: a deterministic paired counterfactual from provider seeds

comparison_invariants: same pinned DeepSeek model, DeepInfra provider, Docker image, goal contract, clean replay, minimal boundary, and safety caps
the Official evaluator is unavailable until model generation terminates
each episode has a fresh construction container and episode-local package cache
no cross-case package mapping, operation ranking, rollback, or container checkpoint is used
B-FSR may execute the same public goal through its unrestricted shell; D-LEDGER changes how the resulting state is measured and retained
tokens and cost are measured outcomes, not optimization cutoffs; shared high safety caps only prevent unbounded execution

design.provider_seed_interpretation: logged randomization covariate; determinism is not assumed

hypothesis: Sparse global goal observations become more useful when a continuous Agent receives explicit set-valued compatibility deltas and retains nondominated evidence; this should improve candidate formation or shorten nonprogressing search without restricting useful temporary regressions.

primary: generation candidate formed and clean-replay certified
secondary: model requests before first certified candidate
shell actions before first certified candidate
input, output, reasoning, and total tokens
treatment_mechanism: initial, stagnant, improved, regressed, and mixed transitions
raw finding count and unique obligation count

promotion_rule.ambiguous: mechanism acceptance passes but directional criteria do not; retain the implementation unchanged and preregister a broader consumed-case study before deciding
promotion_rule.negative: mechanism acceptance fails, or D-LEDGER has lower candidate formation or Official Pass count than B-FSR, or more than one paired treatment-only loss; do not expose frozen Dev cases
positive_directional_signal: D-LEDGER candidate-formation count is at least B-FSR
D-LEDGER Official Pass count is at least B-FSR
no more than one paired treatment-only loss
at least one paired treatment-only win, or at least 15 percent lower median pre-candidate resource use among comparable successful pairs
promotion_rule.scope: promotion to a broader consumed-case experiment, never a paper-level effect claim

stopping_and_retry_policy.infrastructure_failure: mark the episode censored; any exact-identity retry requires a pre-execution amendment and must retain the failed attempt
stopping_and_retry_policy.model_or_algorithm_failure: record as an outcome and continue the frozen schedule
